<!--
Thank you for contributing! Please follow the steps below to help us review your PR quickly.

- 📝 Use a meaningful title: type(scope): description
- 🔍 Add or edit tests to reflect the change
- 📄 Update README or docs if the API or behavior changed
- 💬 Add a changeset describing the change: bunx changeset
-->

## Description

<!-- Describe the change you are introducing. What does it fix or add? -->

## Type of change

- [ ] **Bug fix** (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] **New feature** (non-breaking change that adds functionality)
- [ ] **Breaking change** (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to change)
- [ ] **Documentation** (docs only, no code change)
- [ ] **Refactor** (no functional changes, no API changes)
- [ ] **Build / CI** (changes to build process or CI configuration)
- [ ] **Other**

## Packages affected

<!-- Which packages are affected by this change? -->

- [ ] `@slash-editor/core`
- [ ] `@slash-editor/react`
- [ ] `site` (docs, playground, registry)
- [ ] Other:

## Checklist

- [ ] `bun run check --fix` passes
- [ ] `bun run test` passes
- [ ] `bun run test:e2e` passes (if editor behavior changed)
- [ ] A changeset has been added to `.changeset/`
- [ ] README or docs updated (if API or behavior changed)
- [ ] PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
